[[Aron Peacebringer]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] of the [[Calian Confederacy]] on [[Shiva IV]], and his wife [[Alisande]] had a '''daughter''' at some point before [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The girl died in infancy after falling ill with a disease that Peacebringer also contracted, although her father ultimately survived.<ref name="The Last Gift From Alderaan" />
